message.content: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","agent_id":"researcher","description":"Use web search to gather authoritative, up-to-date evidence (past ~5 years emphasized) on the commercial status of solid-state batteries. Produce a structured markdown file that includes: an executive summary; a list of companies actively commercializing or piloting (e.g., QuantumScape, Solid Power, ProLogium, Toyota, CATL, Samsung, etc.) with their announced product/stage and dates; announced pilot lines / production capacities; reported cell performance metrics (energy density, cycle life, safety incidents, operating temperature) with source links; announced manufacturing methods and materials (sulfide, oxide, polymer, composite) and any scale-up demonstrations; cost or cost-projection figures where available; notable patents or IP disputes reported; analyst timeline projections; and an explicit list of reported technical and supply-chain blockers (interface stability, dendrite formation, stack pressure, electrolyte manufacturing, material supply, yield, testing/qualification). For each claim include a citation link and short note on credibility. Save as raw_findings.md.","dependencies":[],"produces":"raw_findings.md","consumes":[],"rationale":"collect primary evidence and citations via web search","needs_tools":["web_search"]},{"id":"s2","agent_id":"data_analyst","description":"Read raw_findings.md and extract quantitative and comparable data into a concise analytical markdown: tables of reported energy density, cycle life, cost estimates, announced manufacturing capacity and dates; timeline chart (textual) synthesizing vendor timelines and independent analyst projections; a prioritized list of technical and commercial blockers with estimated impact severity and rough time-to-resolution ranges; count of recent patent filings by major players (if mentioned in raw findings); and a short methods note describing assumptions and confidence levels. Highlight any conflicting claims and mark where more data is needed. Save as analysis_report.md.","dependencies":["s1"],"produces":"analysis_report.md","consumes":["raw_findings.md"],"rationale":"translate qualitative findings into quantitative, comparable analysis","needs_tools":["read_file"]},{"id":"s3","agent_id":"creative","description":"Produce a polished, user-facing report in markdown (2–4 pages) that synthesizes the analysis_report.md into: a one-paragraph executive summary of current commercial readiness; clear answer to 'where they stand commercially' and 'what still blocks mass production' with short evidence bullets; an actionable timeline and confidence estimate; recommended signals to watch and next research steps; and an appendix listing key companies, timelines, and sources (pulled from analysis_report.md). Format for a non-technical decision-maker and save as final_report.md.","dependencies":["s2"],"produces":"final_report.md","consumes":["analysis_report.md"],"rationale":"convert analytical findings into a clear, decision-ready report","needs_tools":["read_file","write_file"]}]}
